text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text:
You never listened to me at all,
but this looks like it'll be my final "Bad!"♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
全然言うことを聞いてくれなかったけど、
これが最後の
『めっ』
になりそうっ♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep, lol.
We've already got plenty of good footage,
so hurry up and get defeated already~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそうｗ
撮れ高じゅーぶんだから、
さっさと倒されちゃってくださーい♡

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Fubuki, you're so mean.
That little guy fought as hard as he could, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
フブキってば
お口わる～い。
あの子だって、
一生懸命戦ってきたんだからね？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Uh, isn't that wording kinda brutal too?
Like, "No matter how hard a loser tries, it's pointless," right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
その言い方もエグくね？
ザコががんばってもムダじゃん的な？

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Vampy-chan is just making sure
to praise anyone who did their best♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう？
ヴァンピィちゃんは
がんばった子を、
ちゃーんと褒めてるだけだよ♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Vampy-chan, did somebody rub off on you?
Eh, whatever♪
Now then, let's wrap this up, you bunch of loser seafood♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～？　
ヴァンピィちゃん、
誰かから影響受けたりした？
ま、
いいや♪
じゃ、
パパっと片付けちゃおっか、
ザコザコの海産物さん♡
